'''Southern Rim NavHaz'''<ref name="GG" /> was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|121&ndash;122|Ison Corridor}}</ref> agency that monitored [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] hazards in the southern portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GG" /> It was in existence by the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|era]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Date">"[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which details the Southern Rim NavHaz agency, is set during the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]] and [[New Republic era]]s ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]; see {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}).</ref>

[[Ison system/Legends|Ison]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the Outer Rim's [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region, was enclosed by [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] wisps that made hyperspace travel through the area risky. Southern Rim NavHaz reported that within a few [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]<ref name="GG" /> these coalescing [[Gas/Legends|gases]] and debris would effectively close the Rimward end of the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], rendering the route obsolete.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Southern Rim NavHaz agency was created for "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|online]] supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG" />
